 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # For each non-background color whose cells form a diagonal segment, extend
    # that segment in both directions until the grid edge. Preserve other cells.
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells = defaultdict(list)
    bg = max(set(v for row in out for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in out))
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                cells[v].append((r, c))
    for color, pts in cells.items():
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        # Find diagonal direction from a pair with slope +/-1.
        found = None
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2, c2 in pts[i+1:]:
                if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                    found = dr, dc
                    break
            if found: break
        if found:
            dr, dc = found
            # Every observed cell on that same diagonal line is part of it; extend
            # from each to both ends, only painting background.
            seed = pts[0]
            # choose a seed on the detected line by finding a matching pair
            pair = next(((p,q) for i,p in enumerate(pts) for q in pts[i+1:] if abs(q[0]-p[0])==abs(q[1]-p[1]) and q[0]!=p[0]), None)
            if pair:
                r, c = pair[0]
                while 0 <= r-dr < h and 0 <= c-dc < w:
                    r -= dr; c -= dc
                while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                    if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = color
                    r += dr; c += dc
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Demo 1: extend diagonal 1s from (16,1),(17,2) through lower edge.
    a=[[6]*15 for _ in range(25)]
    a[15][0]=9; a[15][1]=5; a[16][0]=5; a[16][1]=1; a[17][2]=1
    x=transform(a)
    assert all(x[r][r-14]==1 for r in range(17,25))
    # Demo 2: simultaneous diagonal streaks 3 and 4.
    b=[[7]*24 for _ in range(14)]
    for r,c,v in [(7,13,3),(7,16,4),(8,14,3),(8,15,4),(9,14,3),(9,15,0),(10,13,3)]: b[r][c]=v
    x=transform(b)
    assert x[0][6]==3 and x[0][23]==4 and x[13][10]==3
    # Demo 3: diagonal color 3 and 2 streaks.
    c=[[7]*12 for _ in range(16)]
    for r,col,v in [(3,5,8),(3,8,3),(4,6,8),(4,7,3),(5,6,3),(5,7,2),(6,5,3),(6,8,2)]: c[r][col]=v
    x=transform(c)
    assert x[0][2]==8 and x[0][11]==3 and x[15][0]==3 and x[9][11]==2
    print('demonstrations verified')
    t=[[9]*18 for _ in range(7)]
    t[3][2]=5;t[4][0]=4;t[4][1]=5;t[5][0]=2;t[5][1]=1;t[6][2]=1
    print(transform(t))
",
 "cross_profile": false
